Driver metadata failures, not native numerical defects

modifications: SCHEMA bumped to mlx2.direct-model.ragged-pld.v2; new per-lane evidence tag EVIDENCE = mlx2.ragged-pld.lane-evidence.v2. Records without it (every v1 receipt) are incomparable for bit parity: no retroactive upgrade from legacy logprob_rows hashes

Driver.run: one logprob row digest per delivered token up to --logprob-rows, the unchanged state_digest([row]) storage digest; a response without logprobs records state_digest(None) in its slot instead of shifting later rows. Lane records add evidence, logprob_rows_requested (protocol bound), logprob_rows_expected = min(requested, delivered tokens) and logprob_row_digests (the full digest records). logprob_rows / logprob_rows_status stay as readable duplicates derived from the digests

row_evidence_refusal (pure): compare needs the protocol bound from the caller (run_all passes args.logprob_rows); 0 is explicitly unavailable; the record must carry the evidence tag, the same requested bound, expected equal to min(bound, its own delivered tokens), exactly that many digests (truncated or extra refused), every digest passing the unchanged paired_direct_ab.snapshot_refusal, and duplicate hash/status fields consistent with the digests. Each arm is checked independently; equal-but-incomplete never passes; complete digests that differ are still bit differences

final and continuation state: both arms' digests go through snapshot_refusal before any equality test (missing/uppercase/malformed sha256, a reason, extra fields, unavailable or metadata_unavailable are incomparable even when the dicts are equal); covered_tokens must be a positive int on both arms; complete wrong hashes remain bit differences

Driver.continuation returns status unavailable with a refusal reason (tokens and final_state kept for diagnosis) when the continuation final state is not a complete digest; compare re-validates continuation records independently (status, non-empty int token list, snapshot_refusal on final_state)
removed lane stays prefix-only (no final/continuation state required) but an empty removed prefix is incomparable instead of vacuously equal; survivors keep every strict requirement

unchanged: tokens/math/coverage/verdict policy, the ordinary reference, state_digest, snapshot_refusal, paired_direct_ab.py, final-state digesting before the continuation reuses the cache, cache-only state scope (not RNG, scheduler or full transaction state)
